senses.gloss:
ITA-7.2.8.8 kukkutandatvak कुकुटाण्डत्वक्
Hen’s eggshell
Duly processed kukkutanda tvak is employed as a standalone medicine or as an ingredient in the preparation of polyherbo-mineral pharmaceutical formulations.

ITA-3.16.44 kukundaraḥ (marma) कुकुन्दरः (मर्म)
Vulnerable location(s) on either side of back near the ischial tuberosity
Two in number (one on each side) which when injured leads to paralysis and loss of sensation in the lower half of the body.

ITA-5.71.2 kukūṇaka कुकू णकः
Ophthalmia neonatorum
A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: swelling of the eyes; coppery redness of eyes; inability to see; pain in eyelids; stickiness of eyelids; rubbing of ears; rubbing of eyes; rubbing of nose; frontal headache; pain in eyes; irritation in nose; photophobia; difficulty in opening eyes.

ITA-8.3.2 kukūlapācanam कुकूलपाचनम्
Cooking with steam
The process of cooking with the aid of steam.

ITA-3.5.1 udaram, kukṣiḥ, jaṭharam उदरम्, कुक्षिः, जठरम्
Abdomen

IT.3.11.12 vṛkkā, kāleyam, kāleyakam, kukṣigolakaḥ वृक्कः, कालेयम्, कालेयकम्, कुक्षिगोलकः
Kidney
